name: TaskBench
description: TaskBench is a comprehensive benchmark framework designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in task automation, focusing on task decomposition, tool selection, and parameter prediction stages. It uses a Tool Graph representation and a multi-faceted evaluation methodology combining automated construction with human verification to assess performance across different task complexities and domains.
reputation: TaskBench is a relatively new but well-regarded benchmark in the LLM tool-use literature, with growing interest for evaluating task decomposition and agentic automation beyond simple QA.
notes: Introduces the concept of Tool Graph and TaskEval evaluation methodology; benchmark covers multiple stages of task automation.
